name: [x99.9 STATS] Button Bobux Simulator
desc:
Hello! Welcome to Button Bobux Simulator, the goal is to get as much Bobux as possible and get on the leaderboards! Push buttons to buy stats to get more and more BOBUX!
This game is not an incremental, but a button simulator!

Join the Community Server for the change log!

NOTE: YOU CANNOT GET REAL ROBUX FROM THIS GAME!
